items.stem: Select TWO reasons to use a symbol such as :name instead of the string 'name' as a hash key.

options.rationale: Symbols cannot be mutated, making them stable keys.

options.text: The same symbol references one object, saving allocations
options.rationale: Identical symbols are the same object, unlike new string instances.

options.text: Symbols can store multi-line text better than strings
options.rationale: Symbols are identifiers, not text containers.
Symbols carry no ordering guarantee as keys.

items.explanation: Symbols cannot be mutated, making them stable keys.

items.stem: What does passing a block to a method and calling yield do?

options.text: It invokes the caller-supplied block from inside the method
options.rationale: yield runs the attached block, optionally passing arguments to it.

options.text: It returns from the method immediately
options.rationale: yield calls the block; it does not return from the method.

options.text: It defines a new method at runtime
It raises an error if a block is given
options.rationale: yield requires a block; it errors only when none is given.
